## Summary

Ghaith Mefteh has 2+ years of full-time experience, plus a year of part-time
production work during his degree, and works across the entire request path rather
than a single layer: the screen in the browser, the app on the phone, the API behind
them, and the database under that. He joined AzertyUI as its first engineering hire in
August 2024 and became technical director in January 2026: he leads a team of four
engineers, reviews every pull request and reports to the CEO. He built the core of the
chalet-montagne.com rebuild (a marketplace of 10,000+ chalets) solo from April 2025,
then led the team of four through it to delivery in July 2026, and since August 2026
leads the team building AzertyUI's own management platform on .NET microservices.

He is open to remote roles and relocation within the EU — full-stack, backend-leaning,
or mobile — and takes freelance projects through the services pages.

## Technical skills

- Backend: .NET, ASP.NET Core, microservices, gRPC, API Gateway, Symfony, PHP,
  Doctrine ORM, FastAPI, Python, REST API design, WebSockets
- Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQLite, Hive — query optimization, caching
- Frontend: Angular 21, React, TypeScript
- Mobile: Flutter, Dart, SwiftUI, GetX, Provider, Firebase — published to both the
  Apple App Store and Google Play, owning release engineering (Codemagic CI/CD,
  signing certificates, provisioning profiles, Xcode, store review)
- Infrastructure and delivery: Docker, Docker Compose, Apache2, GitLab CI/CD,
  GitHub Actions, AWS, Linux, WireGuard, SSH
- Quality: PHPUnit, PyTest, SonarQube, Sentry, code review, SOLID
- AI-assisted development: Claude Code
- Design-to-code: translating Figma designs screen by screen into Flutter widgets

## Measured results

- Marketplace scale: 10,000+ chalets listed on chalet-montagne.com
- Search page load time on that marketplace: reduced from 20–50 seconds to 4–6 seconds
- Test suite: grown to 390+ tests behind GitLab CI
- Image bandwidth: reduced by approximately 60% via on-demand WebP and multi-size caching
- SOC Rugby app: 2,000+ fans, 99.8% crash-free sessions (Sentry)
- SmartCare app: 40+ doctors and 3,000+ patients

## Production projects

### Company management platform — Technical director, AzertyUI, since August 2026
AzertyUI's own product, where developers, executives and accountants manage absences,
vacations, expenses, tickets and requests, and access contracts, payslips and company
paperwork. Ghaith leads the team of four building it. .NET (ASP.NET Core) microservices
behind an API Gateway, gRPC between services, Angular 21 front end, automated tests.
Alongside it he built the company's server monitoring dashboard: SSH login tracking
with suspicious-login alerts, per-developer access through generated WireGuard VPN
configs, container monitoring, alerts when the master server goes down, and backups.
Stack: .NET, ASP.NET Core, gRPC, API Gateway, Angular 21, WireGuard, Docker.

### chalet-montagne.com — AzertyUI, April 2025 – July 2026
French ski-chalet rental marketplace listing 10,000+ chalets, rebuilt on Symfony while
it kept selling. Ghaith built the core solo from April 2025 (software engineer), then
led a team of four to delivery in July 2026 (technical director). SOLID with SonarQube quality
gates, shipped through GitLab CI/CD, Docker Compose and Apache2. Legacy data and
business logic migrated with functional parity; the search and listing engine rewritten
with caching, query optimization and parallelized data processing. Delivered the
public booking site, an owner back office (listing setup, availability calendars,
automated emails and reminders) and an admin dashboard (revenue tracking, user
blocking, secure user impersonation for support), plus seasonal pricing, two-way iCal
sync, suspicious-login detection and database-cleaning cron jobs.
Stack: Symfony, Doctrine, MySQL, PHPUnit, SonarQube, GitLab CI/CD, Docker.
Live at https://www.chalet-montagne.com/

### SOC Rugby — Software engineer, AzertyUI, August 2024 – March 2025
Official app of the Chambéry rugby club, built solo. Match calendar and reminders, live
scores, rankings, messaging and push notifications. Built in Flutter with GetX and
SQLite, plus an iOS home-screen widget in SwiftUI, published to the App Store and Google Play, used by 2,000+ fans at 99.8%
crash-free sessions. Started from a Figma design translated screen by screen into
Dart/Flutter widgets. Owned releases end to end with Codemagic CI/CD and Sentry.
Stack: Flutter, Dart, GetX, SQLite, SwiftUI, Codemagic, Sentry, Xcode.

### SmartCare — Mobile engineer (part-time, remote, alongside studies), Hope Horizon Health & Care, July 2023 – August 2024
Patient–doctor app for Tunisia, live on Google Play and used by 40+ doctors and 3,000+
patients: appointment booking and reminders, real-time messaging, push notifications,
ambulance calls on Google Maps, Google Sign-In, QR code scanning, medical AI features.
The only mobile engineer; also built the FastAPI backend on MongoDB, deployed to AWS
with GitHub Actions, and the ReactJS web.
Stack: Flutter, Provider, GetX, Hive, FastAPI, MongoDB, ReactJS, AWS.
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hopehorizonworld.smartcare

### Forklift-mounted warehouse terminal — Engineering internship, L-Mobile, 2024
Tablets mounted on forklifts giving warehouse operators live inventory and logistics
data while moving. Five warehouse-management modules integrating Microsoft Dynamics
365 Business Central over C#/.NET and REST.
Stack: C#/.NET, D365 Business Central, REST.

## Side projects

- Sakia: Remote control for farm water pumps — an Expo app talking MQTT to an ESP32
  in the field, in Arabic, French and English.
- Pulse: An AI writing companion for LinkedIn that drafts posts in the user's own
  voice, mobile-first, with its own design system.
- Conforma: Audits documents against legal obligations using rule-based checks backed
  by a structured catalog of legal requirements.
